name: Rainbow Six 3: Raven Shield
author: michaelconne@gmail.com
description: IMPORTANT: This image writes game data to /rvs (hardcoded). Pterodactyl mounts data at /home/container by default, causing an immediate startup crash (exit code 1). Fix: create a Panel Mount (Admin → Mounts) with Target = /rvs and assign it to this server. See the README for full steps. Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six 3: Raven Shield is a tactical first-person shooter released in 2003, featuring squad-based counter-terrorism missions with a strong emphasis on planning and precision. The dedicated server supports cooperative and adversarial multiplayer modes including Terrorist Hunt, Team Deathmatch, Bomb, Hostage Rescue, and Escort Pilot. This egg uses the OpenRVS community patch to restore server browser functionality and improve compatibility with modern systems.

variables.name: Game Preset
variables.description: Server game mode preset. Sets map rotation, game types, and server settings. Valid values: COOP, ADVERSARIAL, DEATHMATCH, TEAMDEATHMATCH, BOMB, HOSTAGERESCUE, ESCORTPILOT

variables.name: Server Port
variables.description: Primary UDP game port. The server beacon port will be PORT+1000 (default 8777) and the beacon port will be PORT+2000 (default 9777). All three ports must be allocated in the panel.

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: The name displayed in the server browser.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Maximum number of players allowed on the server.

variables.name: Map Slot 0
variables.description: Map name for rotation slot 0. Valid maps: Airport, Alpines, Bank, Garage, Import_Export, Island_Dawn, MeatPacking, Mountain_High, Oil_Refinery, Parade, Peaks, Penthouse, Presidio, Prison, Shipyard, Streets, Training, Warehouse

variables.name: Game Type Slot 0
variables.description: Game type for map slot 0. Valid values: R6Game.R6TerroristHuntCoopGame — Terrorist Hunt (Co-op), R6Game.R6TeamBomb — Team Bomb, R6Game.R6HostageRescueAdvGame — Hostage Rescue, R6Game.R6TeamDeathMatchGame — Team Deathmatch, R6Game.R6EscortPilotGame — Escort the Pilot, R6Game.R6DeathMatch — Deathmatch. An invalid game type will cause the server to exit on startup with an error.
